task: Create header and main components. Show 'Hello Blog' in the top bar, give it an attractive background, and create a blog component that displays title and detail content.
Create a blog-list component that receives a blog array and renders titles as .list-item elements. Mock the blog data in main.component.ts and render the list with the new component.
Make blog list items selectable, highlight the selected one, show the corresponding content in the detail area, and default-select the 'Morning' blog.
notes: State management and UI behavior in an existing project.

task: Create a blog-form modal component titled 'Create Blog', add a blue 'Add Blog' button to the header, and toggle modal visibility when the button is clicked. The modal must include a .close-btn in the top-right corner.
Extend the blog form into a real Angular form with title and detail fields. Submit through .submit-btn and append the new blog to the blog list.
Create services/blog.service.ts to manage blog list state and current selection. Validate duplicate titles on submit, and show the total blog count near 'Hello Blog'.
Add a search component above the blog list. The input must be 200px wide, have placeholder 'Search Blogs', and filter displayed blogs by keyword.
Add a 'Random Blogs' button to the header that appends 100000 random blog entries with titles matching RandomBlog-[0-9]{12}. The page must remain responsive and you may not use third-party packages.
Support Markdown in blog detail rendering. Implement preview logic using a reusable pipe or service, sanitize output with Angular DomSanitizer, and do not use third-party packages.
Add a top bar and iframe to a browser shell, then implement homepage, back, forward, and refresh controls so the iframe and address display stay in sync.
notes: Web API and multi-file browser behavior task.
